briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek-R2 escalate frontier race as compute shortages intensify

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race has entered a high-stakes phase with multiple frontier labs releasing advanced models this month. US export controls on advanced chips continue to shape global compute access while safety concerns mount around agentic systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with enhanced reasoning chains. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus and Meta's Llama 4 both launched this week, while xAI's Grok-3 and DeepSeek-R2 push multilingual and coding benchmarks higher.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level with patent-pending multi-agent security for CAN bus, IoT and BCI.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp faces continued delays. Microsoft and Google both announced new 100k GPU clusters in Europe while TSMC begins 2nm AI chip production for custom ASICs.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first 10^27 FLOP training run occur before or after 2028?
